polishOriginalHint: After editing the original, run Guided polish again before sending
guidanceLabel: Guidance (hidden, appended at end of prompt)
sectionSendDesc: Guided send and Guided regenerate share the injection order, role, and prefix below.
injectionOrderSendDesc: Post-user merge order (lower = closer to user). Default 0.
guidanceRoleDesc: Role used when injecting guidance text. Default system. Use user for APIs like Gemini that require the last turn to be user; avoid assistant unless another user turn follows.
systemPrefixDesc: Prefix before the guidance body (role is set by Guidance message role above).
sectionReviseDesc: Injects the assistant draft first, then the guidance sentence. Order, role, and prefix below apply only to Guided revise.
injectionOrderReviseSystemDesc: Guidance sentence slot (role set by Guidance message role below). Default 1.
reviseGuidanceRoleDesc: Role of the guidance sentence after the assistant draft. Default system. Set to user if Gemini errors with "ending with a model turn".
reviseSystemPrefixDesc: Prefix between the assistant draft and guidance body (role set by Guidance message role above).
sectionPolishDesc: Guided polish tab in the Guided send dialog: a second LLM call rewrites the original user text and sends it directly (no guidance injection).
polishSystemPrefixDesc: System instruction for the Guided polish LLM call: rewrite the original user text with recent history; output the polished user message only.
polishHistoryTurnsDesc: How many recent conversation turns to attach via transcript.tail for Guided polish (0–40, default 8).
